requirements.requirement: Working application integrating Qloo as an agentic tool, through an agent framework, or in an existing agent.
requirements.externalCheck: Credentialed Qloo and model workflow with meaningful cultural influence.

requirements.requirement: Externally hosted, fully published functional demo.
requirements.externalCheck: Anonymous end-to-end access and availability through judging.

requirements.requirement: Public GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket repository with necessary code, assets and run instructions.
requirements.externalCheck: Check public repository and clean installation at submitted revision.

requirements.requirement: Detectable open-source license and authorized use of third-party integrations.
requirements.externalCheck: Confirm repository license detection and dependency rights.

requirements.requirement: Text explaining features, functionality and Qloo's role.
requirements.externalCheck: Match final submission description to demonstrated behavior.

requirements.requirement: Eligible entrant, registration and completed Devpost submission.
requirements.externalCheck: Entrant eligibility, ownership, reuse conditions and submission confirmation.

requirements.requirement: English materials or translation, accurate functioning claims and free judge access.
requirements.externalCheck: Verify final materials and access through the judging period.

requirements.requirement: Finalists available for preparation and the November 5 live appearance.

note: Local file checks do not establish eligibility, public access, live integration or a completed submission. The existing-project clause is malformed in the official rules and needs organizer clarification if relied upon.
